run_tokenize_hf_dataset: run datatrove to tokenize a HuggingFace dataset and merge into binary files on Slurm
create_hf_dataset_reader: create a HuggingFaceDatasetReader to load a dataset split and extract a text column
build_document_tokenizer: build a DocumentTokenizer pipeline step to tokenize documents with a specified tokenizer
run_document_tokenizer_merger: run a DocumentTokenizerMerger to merge and shuffle tokenized task files into a final dataset
execute_slurm_pipeline: execute a SlurmPipelineExecutor with a multi-step tokenization pipeline on a Slurm cluster
